BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 1,256,257 ordinary shares on March 27, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share was 291.4941 pence, with the lowest price at 288.8000 pence and the highest at 295.4000 pence. Following these transactions, Serco Group plc has 999,156,667 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and holds 3,589,347 ordinary shares in treasury. The total number of voting rights in the company, excluding treasury shares, is now 999,156,667. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
